name: firecrown-split
raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "1.16.0" %}
{% set python_min = "3.12" %}

# The requirement lists between BEGIN/END GENERATED markers are written from
# the dependencies.yaml manifest in the firecrown repository:
#
#     make feedstock-sync FEEDSTOCK=<path to this checkout>
#
# Edit the manifest, not the generated lines.
#
# Outputs
# -------
# firecrown                the package; depends only on firecrown-deps
# firecrown-deps           what firecrown imports, with truthful bounds
# firecrown-deps-validated the narrower ranges this release was validated
#                          against, generated from firecrown's conda lockfiles
# firecrown-validated      firecrown together with firecrown-deps-validated
# firecrown-devenv         the developer environment
#
# firecrown is pure python and the other four outputs are metapackages, so
# every one of them is noarch: one artifact each, valid on every python and
# platform, and a new python release needs no rebuild here.
#
# When a new upstream release breaks an already published firecrown, tighten
# the bound in the manifest, bump `build.number` below and regenerate.  Because
# firecrown depends on firecrown-deps by version rather than by build string,
# an existing firecrown installation picks up the corrected metapackage without
# a new firecrown release and without a repodata patch.

package:
  name: firecrown-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/LSSTDESC/firecrown/releases/download/v{{ version }}/firecrown-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: cd5e26c4a60187c4333850f5c11beb7877c0f399325da898f7ee493ce2f3a9ee

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - name: firecrown
    build:
      noarch: python
      script: $PYTHON -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    requirements:
      host:
        - python {{ python_min }}.*
        - pip
        - setuptools
        - setuptools-scm
      run:
        - python >={{ python_min }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('firecrown-deps', max_pin='x.x.x') }}
    test:
      requires:
        - python {{ python_min }}.*
      imports:
        - firecrown
      commands:
        - python -c "import firecrown, importlib.metadata as md; assert firecrown.__version__ == '{{ version }}'; assert md.version('firecrown') == '{{ version }}'"

  - name: firecrown-deps
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        # BEGIN GENERATED firecrown-deps (firecrown 1.16.0)
        - python >=3.12
        - astropy  # examples/cluster_number_counts
        - camb <2.0
        - charset-normalizer
        - clmm  # part of the DESC stack; needed indirectly through lsstdesc-crow
        - compilers  # two-phase cosmosis-standard-library installation
        - cosmosis >=3.0
        - cosmosis-build-standard-library
        - cython
        - dill
        - fitsio
        - fuzzywuzzy
        - getdist
        - idna
        - lsstdesc-crow
        - matplotlib-base  # firecrown sacc view
        - more-itertools
        - numcosmo >=0.27
        - numpy >=2.0,<2.4
        - pip >=20.1  # installs cobaya, which conda-forge does not package
        - portalocker
        - pybobyqa
        - pyccl >=2.8.0
        - pydantic
        - pyyaml
        - rich
        - sacc >=2.4
        - scipy >=1.13
        - tabulate
        - typer
        - types-pyyaml
        - typing_extensions
        - urllib3
        # END GENERATED firecrown-deps
    test:
      source_files:
        - dependencies.yaml
        - dependencies-validated.yaml
        - .github/scripts/sync_deps.py
      commands:
        - python .github/scripts/sync_deps.py --check-installed firecrown-deps
        # BEGIN GENERATED firecrown-deps-imports (firecrown 1.16.0)
        - python -c "import astropy, camb, cosmosis, crow, matplotlib, numcosmo_py, numpy, pyccl, pydantic, rich, sacc, scipy, typer, typing_extensions, yaml"
        # END GENERATED firecrown-deps-imports
    about:
      summary: Runtime dependencies of firecrown

  - name: firecrown-deps-validated
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - python
        - {{ pin_subpackage('firecrown-deps', max_pin='x.x.x') }}
      # The bounds firecrown {{ version }} was validated against.  They only
      # narrow what firecrown-deps already installs, so they are expressed as
      # constraints rather than as dependencies.
      run_constrained:
        # BEGIN GENERATED firecrown-deps-validated (firecrown 1.16.0)
        - astropy >=8.0.1,<8.1
        - camb >=1.6.5,<1.7
        - charset-normalizer >=3.5.1,<3.6
        - clmm >=1.16.10,<1.17
        - compilers >=1.11.0,<1.12
        - cosmosis >=3.25.2,<3.26
        - cosmosis-build-standard-library >=1.3,<1.4
        - cython >=3.3.0,<3.4
        - dill >=0.4.1,<0.5
        - fitsio >=1.4.2,<1.5
        - fuzzywuzzy >=0.18.0,<0.19
        - getdist >=1.7.7,<1.8
        - idna >=3.19,<3.20
        - lsstdesc-crow >=1.0.12,<1.1
        - matplotlib-base >=3.11.1,<3.12
        - more-itertools >=11.1.0,<11.2
        - numcosmo >=0.27.0,<0.28
        - numpy >=2.3.5,<2.4
        - pip >=26.2.1,<26.3
        - portalocker >=3.2.0,<3.3
        - pybobyqa >=1.5.0,<1.6
        - pyccl >=3.3.6,<3.4
        - pydantic >=2.13.4,<2.14
        - pyyaml >=6.0.3,<6.1
        - rich >=15.0.0,<15.1
        - sacc >=2.4,<2.5
        - scipy >=1.18.0,<1.19
        - tabulate >=0.10.0,<0.11
        - typer >=0.27.1,<0.28
        - types-pyyaml >=6.0.12.20260815,<6.1
        - typing_extensions >=4.16.0,<4.17
        - urllib3 >=2.7.0,<2.8
        # END GENERATED firecrown-deps-validated
    test:
      # A recipe left behind by a version bump would otherwise build
      # green with the previous release's dependencies.
      source_files:
        - dependencies.yaml
        - dependencies-validated.yaml
        - .github/scripts/sync_deps.py
      commands:
        - python .github/scripts/sync_deps.py --check-installed firecrown-deps-validated
        # BEGIN GENERATED firecrown-deps-imports (firecrown 1.16.0)
        - python -c "import astropy, camb, cosmosis, crow, matplotlib, numcosmo_py, numpy, pyccl, pydantic, rich, sacc, scipy, typer, typing_extensions, yaml"
        # END GENERATED firecrown-deps-imports
    about:
      summary: Runtime dependencies of firecrown, restricted to validated versions

  - name: firecrown-validated
    build:
      # See firecrown-deps: a pure metapackage, and the host section is left
      # out on purpose (conda/conda-build#5245).
      noarch: generic
      # firecrown is noarch too now, so nothing here is architecture-specific.
    requirements:
      run:
        - python
        - {{ pin_subpackage('firecrown', max_pin='x.x.x') }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage('firecrown-deps-validated', max_pin='x.x.x') }}
    test:
      imports:
        - firecrown
    about:
      summary: firecrown, restricted to the dependency versions it was validated against

  - name: firecrown-devenv
    build:
      noarch: generic
    requirements:
      run:
        - python
        - {{ pin_subpackage('firecrown-deps', max_pin='x.x.x') }}
      # cobaya and isitgr are not packaged on conda-forge; install them with
      # pip, or use the environment.yml shipped with firecrown, which does.
        # BEGIN GENERATED firecrown-devenv (firecrown 1.16.0)
        - alabaster
        - babel
        - beautifulsoup4
        - black
        - coverage
        - deno
        - flake8
        - flake8-docstrings
        - glib
        - graphviz
        - hypothesis
        - jupyter
        - linkchecker
        - mypy
        - pandas
        - plotnine
        - pylint
        - pytest
        - pytest-cov
        - pytest-json-report
        - pytest-xdist
        - quarto
        - requests
        - sphinx
        - sphinx-autoapi
        - sphinx-autodoc-typehints
        - sphinx-rtd-theme
        - sphinxcontrib-apidoc
        - types-requests
        # END GENERATED firecrown-devenv
    test:
      # Having a test section at all is what makes conda-build solve this
      # metapackage; without one the output is skipped entirely.  sync_deps.py
      # knows only the two firecrown-deps outputs, so --check-installed cannot
      # cover this one and the tools are checked directly instead.
      commands:
        - python -c "import hypothesis, pandas, plotnine, requests"
        - pytest --version
        - mypy --version
        - black --version
        - flake8 --version
        - pylint --version
        - sphinx-build --version
    about:
      summary: Everything needed to develop, test and document firecrown

about:
  home: https://github.com/LSSTDESC/firecrown
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: DESC Cosmology Likelihood Framework

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - marcpaterno
    - vitenti
    - beckermr
